scripts.dev: concurrently --names "WEB,SERVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.test: concurrently --names "WEB,SERVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run test -w web" "npm run test -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm run lint -w web" "npm run lint -w server"
